paite: Huan Israel aneih tengteng toh apawtkhia a, Beer-sheba atung a, apa Isak' Pathian kiang ah kithoihnate alan hi.
heading: Aigupta Ah Jakob Leh A-inkuan Apai Uh
english: Israel traveled with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.

paite: Pathian in zan a mengmuhna in Israel ahoupih a, "Jakob, Jakob," achi hi. Ama'n, "Hiai ah ka om,” achi hi.
english: God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, “Jacob, Jacob!” He said, “Here I am.”

paite: Ama'n, "Kei Pathian, na pa Pathian ka hi. Aigupta gam a hohsuk lau ke'n. Huai ah chi thupitak in ka hon bawl ding hi.
english: He said, “I am God, the God of your father. Don’t be afraid to go down into Egypt, for there I will make of you a great nation.

paite: Aigupta gam ah na kiang ah ka hong ding a; ka hon pitou nawn ngeingei ding, na sih chiang in Joseph in hon mitsisak ding hi," achi hi.
english: I will go down with you into Egypt. I will also surely bring you up again. Joseph’s hand will close your eyes.”

paite: Huchi in Beer-sheba a kipan Jakob apawt a; Israel suante'n apa uh Jakob leh ataneu chikchikte uh leh azite uh tuanna ding a Pharaoh in kangtalai akhakte ah atuangsak uhi.
english: Jacob rose up from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel carried Jacob, their father, their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

paite: Huchi in Jakob leh asuan tengteng in Kanaan gam a alamkhiak uh, gantate leh vante tawi in, Aigupta gam atungta uhi.
english: They took their livestock, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt—Jacob, and all his offspring with him,

paite: Atapate, atupate, atanute, atunute leh asuan tengteng, Aigupta gam ah alutpihta hi.
english: his sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and he brought all his offspring with him into Egypt.

paite: Hiaite Israel suan Aigupta gam a lut, Jakob leh atapate min ahi uh: Jakob ta masa Reuben ahi.
english: These are the names of the children of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.

paite: Reuben tapate Hanok, Pallu, Hezron leh Karmi ahi uh.
english: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

paite: Simeon tapate: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Johar leh Kanaan numei tapa Shaul ahi uh.
english: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.

paite: Levi tapate: Gershon, Kohath leh Merari ahi uh.
english: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

paite: Judah tapate: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez leh Zerah ahi ua; (Kanaan gam ah Er leh Onan asita ua) Perez tapate Hezron leh Hamul ahi uh.
english: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.

paite: Issakar tapate: Tola, Puah, Job leh Shimron ahi uh.
english: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron.

paite: Zebulun tapate: Sered, Elon leh Jahleel ahi uh.
english: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.

paite: Hiaite tengteng Leah tapa, atanu Dinah toh Padan-aram gam a Jakob aneihsakte ahi ua; atapate leh atanute avek un sawmthum-le-thum ahi uh.
english: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty-three.

paite: Gad tapate: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi leh Areli ahi uh.
english: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.

paite: Asher tapate: Jimnah, Ishuah, Isui leh Beriah leh asanggamnu uh Serah ahi uh. Beriah tapate: Heber leh Malkiel ahi uhi.
english: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and Serah their sister. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.

paite: Hiaite Zilpah Laban in atanu Leah kiang a apiak tapate, Jakob aneihsak mi sawm-le-guk ahi uh.
english: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob, even sixteen souls.

paite: Jakob zi Rakil tapate: Joseph leh Benjamin ahi uh.
english: The sons of Rachel, Jacob’s wife: Joseph and Benjamin.

paite: Joseph in Aigupta gam ah tapa Manasseh leh Ephraim anei a, huai mite On kho siampu Potiphera tanu Asenath in amah aneihsakte ahi uh.
english: To Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.

paite: Benjamin tapate: Belah, Beker, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim leh Ard ahi uh.
english: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.

paite: Hiaite Rakil tapa Jakob aneihsakte ahi ua, avek un sawm-le-li ahi uh.
english: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.

paite: Dan tapa Hushim ahi.
english: The son of Dan: Hushim.

paite: Naphtali tapate: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer leh Shillem ahi.
english: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.

paite: Hiaite Bilhah tapate Laban in atanu Rakil kiang a apiak ahi uh. Hiaite Jakob aneihsak a, avek un sagih ahi uh.
english: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob: all the souls were seven.

paite: Jakob tapate' zite sim louh in Jakob kiang a Aigupta gam a lut, akhal a pawt tengteng avek un sawmguk-le-guk ahi uhi.
english: All the souls who came with Jacob into Egypt, who were his direct offspring, in addition to Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were sixty-six.

paite: Joseph in Aigupta gam a tapa aneihte nih ahi ua; Jakob inkote, Aigupta gam a lutte, avek un sawmsagih ahi uhi.
english: The sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two souls. All the souls of the house of Jacob, who came into Egypt, were seventy.

paite: Jakob in Goshen gam lampi na kawkmuh ding in Joseph kiang ah Judah ahoh masasak hi.
heading: Aigupta Ah Jakob Leh A-inkuante
english: Jacob sent Judah before him to Joseph, to show the way before him to Goshen, and they came into the land of Goshen.

paite: Huchi in Goshen gam ah alutta uhi. Joseph in akangtalai abawlkhol a, Goshen gam ah apa dawn ding in ahohtou hi. Akiang ah akigen a, angawng a kun in akap nilouh hi.
english: Joseph prepared his chariot, and went up to meet Israel, his father, in Goshen. He presented himself to him, and fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

paite: Israel in Joseph kiang ah, "Dam in na om a, na mel ka muh nawn ziak in tu'n zaw si ding in ka kimanta,” achi hi.
english: Israel said to Joseph, “Now let me die, since I have seen your face, that you are still alive.”

paite: Joseph in asanggamte leh apa inkuanpihte kiang ah, "Ka va hohtou ding a, Pharaoh ka hilh ding a, akiang ah, ka unaute leh ka pa inkuanpihte, Kanaan gam a-omte ka kiang ahong tungta uh.
english: Joseph said to his brothers, and to his father’s house, “I will go up, and speak with Pharaoh, and will tell him, ‘My brothers, and my father’s house, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.

paite: Amaute ganvulmi, belamching mite ahi ua, abelamhonte uh, abawnghonte uh leh aneih tengteng uh ahon po vek uh, chi in ka va gen ding.
english: These men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of livestock, and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.’

paite: Hichi ahong hi ding a, Pharaoh in nou ahon sap a, bang nasem na hi ua? ahon chih chiang in,
english: It will happen, when Pharaoh summons you, and will say, ‘What is your occupation?’

paite: na sikhate, hon suangtute a kipan naupang chik ka hih lai ua kipan tuni tanpha ganvulmi ka hi uh, na chi ding uh. Huchi in Goshen gam ah na teng thei ding uh," achi hi; belamching mite himhim lah Aigupta mite kihlamtak ahi ngal ua.
english: that you shall say, ‘Your servants have been keepers of livestock from our youth even until now, both we, and our fathers:’ that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians.”
